description_en: Retrieves the configuration for Intelligent Content Analysis
description_zh: 调用GetContentAnalyzeConfig获取智能内容分析的配置
name: GetContentAnalyzeConfig

ContentAnalyzeConfig.description_en: The configuration for Intelligent Content Analysis

Auto.description_en:
Specifies if Intelligent Content Analysis starts automatically after a Media Asset is registered.

Valid values:

`true`: Enabled.

`false`: Disabled. (default)
Auto.description_zh:
媒资注册完成后是否自动发起智能内容分析。

取值：
true：开启
false：不开启，默认为false

SaveType.description_en:
The repository type for saving analysis results. This parameter is valid only when `Auto` is set to `true`. The default is an empty string.

`TEXT`: Label

`FACE`: Face

`DNA`: Image DNA

You can specify multiple values, separated by commas (,). If this parameter is left empty, the analysis results are not saved to any search repository and cannot be used for content search
SaveType.description_zh:
分析结果入库类型，仅当Auto = true 时可配置。默认值为空。
TEXT: 标签
FACE：人脸
DNA：相似图

支持多值，多值以半角逗号（,）分隔。如果此字段为空，智能内容分析的结果默认不入任何搜索库，后续也无法进行任何形式的内容搜索

TemplateId.description_en:
The ID of the Intelligent Content Analysis template. Each template includes the following AI capabilities:

`S00000101-100040`: Text Recognition

`S00000101-100060`: Video Classification and Face Recognition

`S00000101-100070`: Text Recognition, Video Classification, and Face Recognition
TemplateId.description_zh:
智能内容分析模板ID。各模板包含以下AI分析功能：
S00000101-100040 : 文字识别
S00000101-100060 : 视频分类+人脸识别
S00000101-100070 : 文字识别+视频分类+人脸识别
